title: Sleeping workspaces sort to the bottom of the sidebar
body:
`Frame::new` in `decade/src/chrome/frame.rs` orders the sidebar's workspace cards. It sorts `entries` by section first: the ungrouped workspaces come first, then each group's in the order of `groups`. Within a section it sorts by `Reverse(entry.state())`, so the card whose first agent has the most urgent state comes first. Ties keep the picker's order. `Entry::asleep` marks a sleeping workspace, which the card draws with the sleep mark on its disc and the state "asleep". The sort never reads `asleep`, so a sleeping card can sit above awake ones.

## Proposal

Each sleeping workspace sorts below every awake workspace of its own section, and stays in its group. The sort key becomes `(section, entry.asleep, Reverse(entry.state()))`, and sleeping cards keep the picker's order among themselves.

## Out of scope

- A sleeping workspace's card shrinks to one row: decade-ac3cdb.
close_reason: Landed in 710bd05: Frame::new sorts by (section, asleep, Reverse(state)), so sleeping workspaces sit below the awake ones of their section in the picker's order.
